svg.title: Turn Controlled Rights into Collectible Royalties
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-rights-to-royalties; chart type: process_flow; title: Turn Controlled Rights into Collectible Royalties; subtitle: Five evidence-backed handoffs from asset intake to renewal.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Stages show operating sequence, not elapsed months or conversion rates. First-deal planning remains 6–24 months. Recognized revenue consists of operator license fees and royalties, excluding licensees' underlying product sales.; caption: Every handoff produces an inspectable record; a signed license does not replace usage evidence or a reconciled royalty statement.; stages: label: Establish ownership; value: Signed rights dossier and exception register; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Collect assignments, contributor agreements, registration records, encumbrances, and sublicensing authority. Apply 35 U.S.C. 261 and 17 U.S.C. 204 to relevant transfers.; label: Define licensed scope; value: Asset schedule and permitted-use boundaries; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Specify patent claims, brand categories, catalog assets, or dataset fields; record territory, term, exclusivity, derivative uses, and prohibited redistribution.; label: Validate buyer economics; value: Named buyer and measurable commercial use; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Interview the licensee's product owner, identify a budget owner, and test whether the rights solve a specific product, distribution, or research constraint.; label: Execute measurable terms; value: Royalty schedule and enforceable reporting obligations; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Document royalty base, permitted deductions, minimum guarantees, payment dates, audit access, cure periods, quality controls, and termination consequences.; label: Reconcile and renew; value: Matched usage, statements, invoices, and receipts; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Join licensee reports to invoice records in SQLite; schedule renewal alerts and exception reviews. Investigate missing territories, unexplained deductions, and late reports.

text.title: Turn Controlled Rights into Collectible Royalties
text.tspan: Turn Controlled Rights into Collectible Royalties

circle.title: label: Establish ownership; value: Signed rights dossier and exception register; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Collect assignments, contributor agreements, registration records, encumbrances, and sublicensing authority. Apply 35 U.S.C. 261 and 17 U.S.C. 204 to relevant transfers.

text.title: Collect assignments, contributor agreements, registration records, encumbrances, and sublicensing authority. Apply 35 U.S.C. 261 and 17 U.S.C. 204 to relevant transfers.

circle.title: label: Define licensed scope; value: Asset schedule and permitted-use boundaries; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Specify patent claims, brand categories, catalog assets, or dataset fields; record territory, term, exclusivity, derivative uses, and prohibited redistribution.

text.title: Specify patent claims, brand categories, catalog assets, or dataset fields; record territory, term, exclusivity, derivative uses, and prohibited redistribution.

circle.title: label: Validate buyer economics; value: Named buyer and measurable commercial use; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Interview the licensee's product owner, identify a budget owner, and test whether the rights solve a specific product, distribution, or research constraint.

text.title: Interview the licensee's product owner, identify a budget owner, and test whether the rights solve a specific product, distribution, or research constraint.

circle.title: label: Execute measurable terms; value: Royalty schedule and enforceable reporting obligations; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Document royalty base, permitted deductions, minimum guarantees, payment dates, audit access, cure periods, quality controls, and termination consequences.

text.title: Document royalty base, permitted deductions, minimum guarantees, payment dates, audit access, cure periods, quality controls, and termination consequences.

circle.title: label: Reconcile and renew; value: Matched usage, statements, invoices, and receipts; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Join licensee reports to invoice records in SQLite; schedule renewal alerts and exception reviews. Investigate missing territories, unexplained deductions, and late reports.

text.title: Join licensee reports to invoice records in SQLite; schedule renewal alerts and exception reviews. Investigate missing territories, unexplained deductions, and late reports.

Assumptions: Stages show operating sequence, not elapsed months or conversion rates. First-deal planning remains 6–24 months. Recognized revenue consists of operator license fees and royalties, excluding licensees' underlying product sales.
